items.title: Why Is Pfizer Stock Paying You So Much To Wait?
items.summary: Pfizer (PFE) throws off free cash worth 7.0% of its market value a year, against 4.4% for the median S&P 500 company. Everything turns on whether the cash holds. Management's answer is a wait: it says it is well positioned to return to growth from 2029 onward. A 6.2% dividend yield over the past twelve months is what that wait pays.

items.title: 3 Healthcare Stocks That Fall Short
items.summary: From novel pharmaceuticals to telemedicine, most healthcare companies are on a mission to drive better patient outcomes. Players catalyzing medical advancements have benefited from elevated demand, and their momentum is only rising as the industry has posted a 30% gain over the past six months, beating the S&P 500 by 16.7 percentage points.

items.title: Big Pharma Is Pouring Billions Into China’s Biotechs
items.summary: Big Pharma firms have cut license deals worth tens of billions of dollars for cancer drugs invented in China.

items.title: Should You Buy Bristol Myers Squibb Stock Right Now for the Yield Alone?
items.summary: As management tackles key issues head-on, Bristol Myers Squibb stock offers a steady 4% yield, with further upside potential.

items.title: How Much Do You Really Need Invested in Bristol Myers Squibb to Collect $10,000 a Year?
items.summary: Collecting $10,000 a year from Bristol Myers Squibb sounds straightforward until you factor in a looming patent cliff that threatens the very earnings funding that payout. Here is what the math and the risk actually look like together.

items.title: Is AbbVie Stock Actually Overpriced?
items.summary: AbbVie (ABBV) grew revenue 10.4% over the past twelve months and turned 33.9% of it into operating profit, second only to Eli Lilly among its peers on both counts. Its stock returned 24.9% over the same twelve months, fifth of the six. What the business delivered and what the market paid for it have come apart.

items.title: MRK Banks on Growing Pipeline & New Drugs to Offset Keytruda LOE
items.summary: Merck is expanding its pipeline and newer drug portfolio to offset Keytruda's 2028 LOE and drive long-term growth.

items.title: Bristol Myers’ Cancer Therapy Win Strengthens its Oncology Pipeline
items.summary: Bristol-Myers Squibb Company (NYSE:BMY) said its experimental CAR-T cell therapy, arlocabtagene autoleucel (arlo-cel), met the main goal of a mid-stage trial in patients with advanced multiple myeloma who had already gone through four major classes of standard treatments.
